pr_title: Fix equal operation for typed enums
pr_body: # Summary Fix #49278 Screen proof: ## How I Fix it `op_binary` can't compare two `builtin_type`. **ENUM_VALUE** returns `Variant::NIL` and **ENUM** returns `Variant::DICTIONARY`. Problem was in default value for `builtin_type`, because for **ENUM_VALUE** we don't set builtin_type and using default `Variant::NIL`

issue_context.title: Incorrect invalid operands when using enums
issue_context.body:
**Godot version:**
Godot master af3ebc96ed07810e001824743fbce1e01f565079

**OS/device including version:**
any

**Issue description:**
When using enums comparisons give a bogus invalid operands error

**Steps to reproduce:**
Use the following code:
```
extends Node

enum Test { ONE, TWO }
var test : Test = Test.ONE

func testing():
	if test == Test.TWO:
		# this is a test
		pass
```

We now get the error ` "Invalid operands "Test (enum)" and "TWO (enum value)" for "==" operator.` on the if statement
comments:
I'm seeing this issue in Godot 4.0 alpha 1.  To reproduce follow the steps in the original description. Removing the type from `var test` will allow comparison to work though...

Edit: Looks like issue already open here #56878
